definitions.explanation: A person in an important position, such as a head of state, minister or senior official, especially one who needs protection. A formal word common in news reports.

examples.japanese: {要人|ようじん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{警護|けいご}→警護：23440_keigo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要人|ようじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Dignitaries from many countries gathered for the conference.

examples.japanese: {要人|ようじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来日|らいにち}→来日：13060_rainichi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周辺|しゅうへん}→周辺：09896_shuuhen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{警備|けいび}→警備：00208_keibi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳重|げんじゅう}→厳重：11887_genjuu⟧になっている。
examples.english: Because a dignitary is visiting Japan, security around the airport has been tightened.

notes:
⟦{要|よう}→要：10000_you⟧ (important) + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person). Used mostly of political and government figures, in contexts of security and diplomacy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {要人|ようじん}⟦{警護|けいご}→警護：23440_keigo⟧: protection of dignitaries
- ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧{要人|ようじん}: senior government figures
- {要人|ようじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{暗殺|あんさつ}→暗殺：10142_ansatsu⟧: assassination of a public figure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- VIP: the loanword, used for celebrities and special guests as well; {要人|ようじん} is narrower and more official
- {大物|おおもの}: a big name, a heavyweight (informal)

WATCH OUT:
Same reading as ⟦{用心|ようじん}→用心：03659_youjin⟧ (caution).
